Name: (CP) d_dott's Yellow Bus
Author: dd0tt
Description:
[line]
[b]✦  d_dott's Yellow Bus  ✦[/b]

[b]If you encounter any issues, please let me know! ♡[/b]
[left][line]
[/left]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53773/53773-1791920814-1113619419.png[/img]

[b]✦ About[/b]
A cozy yellow bus and bus stop sign retexture with seasonal designs for Stardew Valley.
[list]
[*]Automatically changes with the seasons.[/*]
[*]Bus and bus stop sign can be enabled separately.[/*]
[*]Visual changes only. Gameplay remains unchanged.[/*]
[/list][b]✦ Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (Optional)[/*]
[/list][b]✦ Installation[/b]
Extract the ZIP file and place the mod folder in your
Mods folder.
[line]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53773/53773-1791920814-884629746.png[/img]

[b]✦ Settings[/b]
Both options are enabled by default.

[b]✅ EnableBus [/b]
[list]
[*]Enables or disables the seasonal bus retexture, including the body, doors, driver, and front overlay.[/*]
[/list][b]✅ EnableBusStopSign[/b]
[list]
[*]Enables or disables the seasonal bus stop sign independently of the bus.[/*]
[/list][b]✦ How to Configure[/b]
[list]
[*][b]With GMCM:[/b] Change the settings in-game.[/*]
[*][b]Without GMCM:[/b] Close the game and edit
[code]config.json[/code]using
[code]true[/code]or
[code]false[/code][/*]
[/list]Disabling an option only removes this mod's corresponding texture changes. It does not remove the bus or sign.
[b]
✦ Seasonal Updates[/b]
Textures automatically follow the current in-game season.
If textures don't update after an instant season change:
[list]
[*]Sleep until the next day, or[/*]
[*]Toggle the corresponding option OFF and ON again in GMCM, then save.[/*]
[/list][b]✦ Compatibility[/b]
[list]
[*]Avoid using other bus or bus stop sign retextures that modify the same assets, including trolley bus replacements.[/*]
[*]Custom maps may require additional compatibility patches.[/*]
[/list][b]✦ Uninstallation[/b]
Close the game and remove this mod's folder from Mods
[line]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53773/53773-1791920813-1849345.png[/img]

[b]✦ Permissions[/b]
[list]
[*]Personal edits are allowed for private use only.[/*]
[*]Redistribution or reuploading is prohibited.[/*]
[*]Using my assets in other projects requires permission.[/*]
[*]Any use of my artwork (including images and textures) for AI training datasets,
AI image generation, or AI-based modification is strictly prohibited, even for personal use.[/*]
[/list]Please share the official Nexus Mods link instead of the files.
[line]
